title: One projection square for explicit reduction coordinates
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D, a coefficient datum C with prime ℓ distinct from the characteristic, a finite extension E of Q_ℓ, n≥1, and a normalized six-functor operation datum S at n. Assume ℓ is invertible in D.k. Let o be simultaneous-system operations and z their canonical realization data. Let f:X→Y be separated, locally of finite type and quasi-compact between finite-type schemes over D.k. Fix one compactification c of f, a constructible integral object K on X and a constructible integral object L on Y satisfying uniform finite-reduction Tor amplitude. Write M=reduction K and N=reduction L. With sourceMap and targetMap defined in [def-sf-integral-projection-coordinate-data], sourceMap(c,K,L) followed by the simultaneous-system compactificationProjection(c,M,N) equals reduction of the datum projectionComponent(c,K,L) followed by targetMap(c,K,L). There is no refinement or existential choice of coordinate isomorphisms in this assertion.

source.place: Compactification-independence sentence: compatibility of individual refinement maps with counits and j_!, before the projection square is deduced. Integral-system realization steps 1 and 3 of lem-sf-integral-projection-refinement-square.

proof.text: Expand the defining projection into its proper counit factor and proper image of the open tensor factor, retaining the actual datum endpoint transports. ProjectionFactors.factorization proves the datum equality in an arbitrary coefficient category.

Paste the proper-factor coefficient square with the open-factor coefficient square at the explicit middleMap. Reassociate, replace the two successive reductions by reduction of their composite, and use the proved factorization. The result is the unchanged sourceMap/projection/targetMap equation.

proof_origin.place: The proper counit and open tensor factors, pasted in the displayed order. Complete Lean assembly from their two separate coefficient squares; C9, 2026-10-27.

lean.statement:
theorem integralProjectionReductionNormalization
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (C : D.CoefficientDatum)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic C.l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic C.l) E] (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (S : SixFunctorOperationDatum D C E n hn) (hl : IsUnit (C.l : D.k))
    (o : Operations C.l E) (z : Realizations C.l E D o)
    {X Y : SixFunctorSpace D} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsSeparated f.hom.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType f.hom.left] [QuasiCompact f.hom.left]
    (c : Compactification f.hom.left)
    (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory C.l E X.obj.left)
    (L : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory C.l E Y.obj.left)
    (hL : finiteTorConstructibleIntegral C.l E Y.obj.left L.obj) :
    Coordinates.sourceMap D C E S.higher hl o z f c K L ≫
        compactificationProjection C.l E o z.compositors z.openComparisons c
          ((calculus C.l E X.obj.left).reduction.obj K.obj)
          ((calculus C.l E Y.obj.left).reduction.obj L.obj) =
      (calculus C.l E Y.obj.left).reduction.map
        (((S.higher.integralExchange (identitySquare f c)).projectionComponent K L).hom) ≫
          Coordinates.targetMap D C E S.higher hl o z f c K L
